content: Mɑ ɡɑri yi, yi sinɑ boko wururɑ. Yerɑ u seewɑ u yɔɔwɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑrun ɡidɑmbisɑ wɔllɔ. Miyɑ u wɑ̃ɑ u sirenɛ u sumɔ u mɔ̀, nɛn bii Abusɑlɔmu, nɛn bii. Nɑ̀ n dɑɑ ɡu wunɛn ɑyerɔ, yɑ sɑnɔ bo. Nɛn bii Abusɑlɔmu, nɛn bii.
Yerɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Yoɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wee sinɑ boko u sumɔ u kpɑsɑ wɔri mɔ̀ Abusɑlɔmun sɔ̃.
Dɔmɑ ten nɑsɑrɑ ye, yɑ ɡɔsirɑwɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu Dɑfidin tɔmbu kpuron mi. Domi bɑ nuɑ mɑ u sumɔ win bii ɡɔɔn sɔ̃.
Mɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ tɑbu ɡberun di bɑ duɑ wuuɔ kɑ sekuru dɔmɑ te, nɡe be bɑ duki yɑkikirɑmɑ tɑbu ɡberun di.
Sinɑ boko u win wuswɑɑ wukiri u wurɑ mɔ̀ tɑ̃ɑ tɑ̃ɑ u mɔ̀, nɛn bii Abusɑlɔmu, Abusɑlɔmu nɛn bii, nɛn bii.
Ye Yoɑbu u tunumɑ, yerɑ u dɑ u sinɑ boko deemɑ yɛnu sɔɔwɔ. Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee ɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu kpuro sekuru doke ɡisɔ bɛsɛ be sɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bibu kpuro fɑɑbɑ kuɑ kɑ wunɛn kurɔbu kpuro.

Sɑ wɑ wee ɑ wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ kĩ mɑ ɑ be bɑ nun kĩ tusɑ. Domi ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔsi ɡisɔ mɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu kɑ bɛsɛn wiruɡibu sɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wunɛn nɔni sɔɔ. Tɛ̃ nɑ ɡiɑ mɑ Abusɑlɔmu ù n dɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ kpɑ bɛsɛ kpuro sɑ n ɡuwɑ, yɑ koo nun dore.

Adɑmɑ tɛ̃, ɑ yɑrio ɑ dɑ ɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu ɡɔ̃rusu yɛmiɑsiɑ. À n yinɑ ɑ ko mɛ, nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru bɑɑ tɔn turo kun kɑ nun yɔ̃rɑmɔ sɑɑ wɔ̃ku ten di. Kɑɑ mɑɑ wɑhɑlɑ wɑ yɑ n kere ye ɑ wɑɑre sɑɑ wunɛn ɑluwɑɑsirun di n kɑ ɡirɑri ɡisɔ.

Yerɑ sinɑ boko u dɑ u sinɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔwɔ. Mɑ bɑ tɔn be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wee sinɑ boko u yɑrimɑ u sɔ̃ kɔnnɔwɔ. Mɑ be kpuro bɑ nɑ win mi. Dɑfidi u swɑɑ wɔri u wurɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ N deemɑ Isireli be bɑ rɑɑ Abusɑlɔmu swĩi kpuro bɑ duki suɑ. Ben bɑɑwure u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ win yɛnuɔ.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑn bwese ni sɔɔ kpuro bɑ sikirinɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀ Dɑfidi sinɑ bokowɑ u sun wɔrɑ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmɑn di ǹ kun mɑm ko Filisitibɑ. Tɛ̃ wee u yɑkurɑ bɛsɛn tem di Abusɑlɔmun sɔ̃.
Adɑmɑ n wee Abusɑlɔmu wi sɑ bɑndu wɛ̃ mi, u ɡu tɑbu ɡberɔ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ǹ ɡerunɑmɔ su kɑ sinɑ boko nɑɑ dɑ.

N deemɑ Dɑfidi u nuɑ ye Isireli be kpuro bɑ ɡerumɔ. Yerɑ u ɡɔrɑ bu yɑ̃ku kowobu Sɑdɔku kɑ Abiɑtɑɑ sɔ̃ bu dɑ bu Yudɑbɑn ɡuro ɡurobu sɔ̃ bu nɛɛ, beyɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ win dusibu, wi kɑ beyɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɛm tem, ǹ n mɛn nɑ mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ bɑ koo nɛɛ, beyɑ bɑ dɑ̃kuru seemɑ bɑ sinɑ boko nɑɑ nɑ.
U mɑɑ nɛɛ, bu Amɑsɑ sɔ̃ mɑ wi kɑ wi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛm tem. Yen sɔ̃, wi Dɑfidi u koo nùn ko win tɑbu sunɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ Yoɑbun ɑyerɔ. Ù kun kue mɛ, Gusunɔ u be nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ u kĩ.
Mɑ Dɑfidin ɡɑri yi, yi derɑ Yudɑbɑ kpuro bɑ nɔɔ nɛrɑ mɑm mɑm. Mɑ bɑ nùn sɔmɔ ɡɔriɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, u wurɑmɑ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu kpuro.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u ɡɔsirɑmɑ u nɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑrɔ. Dɑfidi u Simɛi suuru kuɑ Mɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ nùn sennɔ dɑ. Bɑ turɑ sere Giliɡɑliɔ kpɑ bu kɑ nùn somi ù n dɑɑ te tɔburɑmɔ.
Mɑ Simɛi, Gerɑ Bɑhurimuɡiin bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bweseru u seewɑ fuuku u kɑ sinɑ boko Dɑfidi sennɔ dɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ sɑnnu.

Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bweseru sɔɔ be bɑ Simɛi swĩimɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000) kɑ sere Sibɑ wi u rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɔɔlun sɔm kowo wi kɑ mɑɑ win bibu wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ win sɔm kowobu yɛndu. Tɔn be kpurowɑ bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ sinɑ boko turiɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑru mi.
Mɑ bɑ sinɑ bokon yɛnuɡibu ɡurɑmɔ bɑ kɑ tɔburɑmɔ kɑ ɡoo nimkuu bu kɑ win nɔnu ɡeu wɑ. Ye sinɑ bokon tii u tɔburɑ u kpɑ, Simɛi wi, u dɑ u yiirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ.
U nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ ku kɔ̃sɑ ye ɡɑrisi ye nɑ nun kuɑ dɔmɑ te ɑ yɑriɔ Yerusɑlɛmun di. A ku ye doke ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ nɑ torɑwɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ yinni, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn bweseru kpuro nɑ bu ɡbiiyɑ n kɑ nun sennɔ nɑ.
Yerɑ Abisɑi Seruyɑn bii u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n ǹ weenɛ bu Simɛi wi ɡo? Domi u wunɛ wi Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ wɔnwɑ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Abisɑi kɑ win mɔɔ Yoɑbu wisɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n bɛɛ wɑ bɛɛ Seruyɑn bibu. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i mɑn yibɛrɛ tɛɛru seesimɔ. N weenɛ bu ɡoo ɡo ɡisɔ? Wɑrɑ kun yɛ̃ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko tɛ̃.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u Simɛi sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ ɡbimɔ.
Dɑfidi u Mɛfibosɛti kĩru sɔ̃ɔsi

Mɛfibosɛti, Sɔɔlun debubu, win tii u sinɑ boko sennɔ dɑ. N deemɑ sɑɑ mìn di sinɑ boko u kpikiru suɑ sere u kɑ wurɑmɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ, Mɛfibosɛti kun win nɑɑsu nim tɛɛnire. U ǹ mɑɑ win nɔɔ sɑnsu kɔnire. Mɛyɑ u ǹ mɑɑ win yɑ̃nu teɑre.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u tunumɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ sinɑ bokon mi, yerɑ sinɑ boko u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Mɛfibosɛti, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ ǹ kɑ mɑn de sɑnɑm mɛ nɑ kpikiru dɔɔ.
Mɛfibosɛti u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɡeemɑ ɑ yɛ̃ mɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛmɔ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ nɛn sɔm kowo sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, u mɑn nɛn kɛtɛku ɡɑɑri bɔkuo kpɑ n kɑ nun dɑ. Adɑmɑ u mɑn bɔrɔ kɔ̃ɔru kuɑ.
Mɑ u dɑ u mɑn sɑnkɑ wunɛn mi. Nɛn yinni sinɑ boko, nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo. A koowo nɡe mɛ n nun wɛ̃re.
Domi ɡɔɔwɑ nɛn bɑɑbɑn bweseru tɑ kɑ weenɛ wunɛn mi. Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, ɑ derɑ nɑ rɑ di kɑ be bɑ dimɔ wunɛn dii yerɔ sɑnnu. Mbɑ kon kpĩ n mɑɑ nun bikiɑ.
Sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ nɑ mɑɑ ɡɑri dɛ̃ɛyɑsiɑmɔ, domi nɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke kɔ mɑ wunɛ kɑ Sibɑ i ko wunɛn debun tem mɛ bɔnu kowɑ.
Yerɑ Mɛfibosɛti u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, Sibɑ u mɑm mɛ kpuro suo. Domi wee ɑ wɔmɑ yɛnuɔ bɑɑni.
Dɑfidi u Bɑɑsilɑi kĩru sɔ̃ɔsi
Bɑɑsilɑi, Gɑlɑdiɡii u mɑɑ nɑ sɑɑ Roɡɛlimun di u kɑ Dɑfidi yɔ̃siri sere Yuudɛnin dɑɑrɔ kpɑ bu dɑɑ te tɔburɑ sɑnnu.
Bɑɑsilɑi wi, u tɔkɔ kuɑ ɡem ɡem. U mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɛnɛ. U mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡobiɡii. Wiyɑ u Dɑfidi nɔɔri sɑɑ ye u wɑ̃ɑ Mɑhɑnɑimuɔ.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɑ ɑ kɑ mɑn tɔburɑ su dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ nɛn mi. Kon nun nɔɔri mɑm mɑm.
Adɑmɑ Bɑɑsilɑi u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃rɑ kun mɑɑ dɛ̃u n sere kɑ nun swĩi su dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.

Wee wɔ̃ɔ wɛnɛwɑ nɑ mɔ. Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kpɛ̃ n ɡeɑ kɑ kɔ̃sɑ wunɑnɑ. Mɛyɑ bɑɑ dĩɑ ni nɑ dimɔ nɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ n mɑɑ ye yɑ do kɑ ye yɑ kun do wunɑnɑ. Yen biru, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kpɛ̃ n tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbun womusu nɔ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, yinni, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ nɑ kon mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn sɔmunu.
Nɑ ǹ turɑ n kɑ ɑre bɛkɛ yinin bweseru wɑ. Kon kɑ nun Yuudɛnin dɑɑru tɔburɑwɑ kpɑ n nun yɔ̃siri fiiko.
Kpɑ ɑ de n ɡɔsirɑ n wurɑ nɛn wuuɔ n ɡbi mi. Kpɑ bu mɑn sike nɛn bɑɑbɑ kɑ nɛn mɛron sikinun bɔkuɔ. Adɑmɑ nɛn bii Kimuhɑmu wee, i doo kɑ wi u n sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ, kpɑ ɑ nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, nɑ wurɑ Kimuhɑmu u kɑ mɑn dɑ. Kon mɑɑ nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ n koo nun wɛ̃re. Ye ɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke n nùn kuɑ kpuro, yeyɑ kon ko.
Sɑnɑm mɛ sinɑ boko kɑ win tɔn be bɑ nùn swĩi bɑ dɑɑru tɔburɑ bɑ kpɑ, yerɑ u Bɑɑsilɑi bɔkɑsi u nùn domɑru kuɑ. Mɑ Bɑɑsilɑi u ɡɔsirɑ u wurɑ win yɛnuɔ.
Sinɑ boko u Giliɡɑlin swɑɑ wɔri. Mɑ Kimuhɑmu u nùn swĩi. Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ sinɑ boko sikirinɛmɔ Yudɑbɑ kpuro kɑ Isirelibɑn sukum bɑ nùn biru wɔ̃ku kuɑ.

Yen biru Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ nɑ sinɑ bokon mi bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ Yudɑbɑ bɛsɛn tundo bisibu bɑ nɑ bɑ nun suɑ ɡbɛnum bɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑru tɔburɑsiɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn yɛnuɡibu, kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu kpuro.
Mɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ Isirelibɑ wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ yeni kuɑwɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɛsɛ kɑ sinɑ boko sɑ sɑ̃ɑ bwese kɛri tiɑ. Nɡe mbɑn mɔruwɑ i mɔ̀. I nuɑ sinɑ boko u sun dĩɑnu wɛ̃ɛmɔwɑ? Nɡe kɛ̃nu ɡɑnɑ i nuɑ u sun kɑ̃.

Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ Yudɑbɑ wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛrɑ sɑ bɛɛ Dɑfidi sinɑ boko mɔru kere sere nɔn wɔkuru. Domi sɑ dɑbiru bo. Bɛsɛrɑ sɑ ɡbiɑ sɑ bwisikɑ su kɑ dɑ su bɛsɛn sinɑ boko suɑmɑ. Mbɑ n kuɑ i kɑ sun ɡɛmɑ. Adɑmɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ bu ɡerusi kɑ dɑm.
Sebɑ u Dɑfidi seesi
